facts.fact: 开篇老年旁白说她时间不多，需要抓紧回忆，她预感他今晚会来。
facts.anchor: My time is running short, I need to make haste. I think he will be coming tonight.

facts.fact: Alexander 没再提起那晚，也没有进一步亲密的举动，她怕再次被拒。
facts.anchor: Alexander had not approached the topic again, made no moves towards a further intimacy.

facts.fact: 她请 Mrs White 帮忙撤掉红天鹅绒床罩，换成米色羽绒被和崭新白床单。
facts.anchor: I recruited Mrs White’s help and had the garish red velvet bedcovers removed, replaced by a simple beige eiderdown, and fresh new sheets, crisp and white.

facts.fact: 她开玩笑说他藏起了蓝胡子的房间，话一出口就后悔。
facts.anchor: I joked he hid Bluebeard’s room from me, a tasteless thing that fell out of my mouth and filled me immediately with regret.

facts.fact: 梦里 Alexander 来救她却变形，口中散发臭鸡蛋与酒精、火与烟的气味。
facts.anchor: Sometimes Alexander came to save me, but as soon as I was in his arms he shapeshifted.

facts.fact: 她泡澡时水下听到低语，声音几乎要灌进她身体。
facts.anchor: The whispers were there, soft voices speaking right in my ears, their words caressing my naked skin.

facts.fact: 浴室镜子雾气上出现「go home」字样。
facts.anchor: in small letters I could have easily missed, was scrawled the line

facts.fact: 结尾她承认自己对 S— House 了解甚少，对墙内有什么更一无所知。
facts.anchor: I knew so little of S— House then, or of what lay inside its dark walls.
